title: Wild's Stews
description: A unique coloured border to each suspicious stew. Plus other variations to choose from
body:
Note: currently updating on request but these should work outside their stated versions.

## Outline
Outlines the suspicious stews with the colour representing the effect

- Negative Stews are tinted red to give you a warning
- Postive Stews have the normal coloured bowls

![Each unique suspicious stew icon, Positive on top, Negative on Bottom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b7d81b5d896d0ac733ffe163ba73c06b623bca10.png)

Made to be simple and minimalistic while keeping close to the original texture.


## Detailed
More detailed to know the effects and flowers without memorising
- Icon of effect above bowl
- Icon(s) of flowers below the bowl

![Each unique suspicious stew icon, Positive on top, Negative on Bottom](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5f28167cec7806fdbf76e342221e3858b0535f26.png)


## Effect
Only the effect icon and outline, no flowers
